0022600133.text: The Washington Wizards (2-2, 1-1 on the road) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (2-1, 2-0 at home) for the fifth game of the Wizards' season, with Washington currently 9th in the East and third in the Southeast, one game back, and Cleveland second in the Central, also one game back. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Justin Champagnie is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision. There have been no meetings yet this season, but Washington lost all four games against Cleveland in 2025-26, most recently 130-117 in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
